source: Plan of the Yuanmingyuan Imperial Garden-Palace, Princeton University Art Museum 2022-27 a-c
pixel_frame: plan_x, plan_y: pixels on the mosaic, origin top-left
datum: control points WGS84 (EPSG:4326); fitted in UTM 50N (EPSG:32650)

independent_check.warning: Not a blind test. The kept set was edited after seeing errors: plan positions re-read on a sheet that marked the prediction, 3 large misses dropped (see rejected). first_pass is the unedited first reading; it includes misreadings of the plan, so it is an upper bound.

points.feature: 蓬岛瑶台 north-west islet, polygon centroid
蓬岛瑶台 east islet, polygon centroid

YM-west.note: Few surviving shapes; many ditches are modern. No anchor on the plain x 700-1500, y 3500-5600, in the north-west fields, or at the north-west and south-west corners. Pond outlines look schematic.

YM-houhu.note: 后湖, 前湖 and the 曲院风荷 lake match in size and shape.

YM-fuhai.note: Shore outline matches; the 蓬岛瑶台 islands match closely. The north shore points are less sure.

CC-lakes.note: Closest fit: 含经堂 enclosure, 海岳开襟 and 玉玲珑馆 islands. No independent check here.

XYL.note: Buildings keep their east-west order. One independent check only, read off the axis, so this rests on leave-one-out.

QC.note: East lake fits well, west part less so. Schematic in places: the 鉴碧亭 island is drawn round and is square today, and 正觉寺 is drawn narrower than its surviving walls. These lakes were re-dug in modern times (assumed, not checked), so shore points may not be original.

walls.note: Short fragments and modern roads assumed to follow the old line. Weakest area: no independent check, both western corners unanchored.
